definitions.explanation: A particular manner or way something is designed or done, especially in art or architecture.

examples.japanese: この{建物|たてもの}は{西洋|せいよう}{様式|ようしき}だ。
examples.english: This building is in Western style.

examples.japanese: {生活|せいかつ}{様式|ようしき}が{変|か}わった。
examples.english: The way of living has changed.

examples.japanese: {書類|しょるい}は{指定|してい}の{様式|ようしき}で{提出|ていしゅつ}してください。
examples.english: Please submit the documents in the specified format.

notes:
{様式|ようしき} refers to style or form, often in artistic or cultural contexts.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {生活|せいかつ}{様式|ようしき}: lifestyle, way of living
- {建築|けんちく}{様式|ようしき}: architectural style
- {和|わ}{様式|ようしき}: Japanese style
- {洋|よう}{様式|ようしき}: Western style

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {方式|ほうしき}: system, method (more technical)
- {形式|けいしき}: format, formality
